comments.author: Cash
comments.body:
Please note that this ship goes 7 + 2 for a total of 9 mods but lack 200 base SHP which restricts its upper end of mod limits.

For example, at g3; the upper limit for sails on most heavy class ships is 117, this one caps out at 95.

Still a very quick ship but keep this in mind or consider this in your plans when modding and heavy class ship that does not have 200 ship handling proficiency to start with.
